  python:
    min_pin: x.x

zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
name: cycamore
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.6.0"

package:
  name: cycamore
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/cyclus/cycamore/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 5ba4e84095a0e7e13316d9364053786a15d777bf862193401a0ea8337df0f8fc
  patches:
    # Boost 1.89 removed the compiled Boost.System stub library and Boost 1.89 to
    # 1.91 have no CMake package for it, so requiring the system component fails;
    # same change as made to cyclus in https://github.com/cyclus/cyclus/pull/1985
    - patches/make-the-system-component-of-Boost-optional.patch
    # (int)1e299 is INT_MIN with GCC 15, hanging SinkTest.RandomNormalFreq; upstream
    # uses CY_LARGE_INT from https://github.com/cyclus/cycamore/pull/606, which
    # needs a newer cyclus, so use INT_MAX instead
    - patches/do-not-use-1e299-as-an-int-default-in-sink.patch
    # Decommission() in Reactor::Tick() erases the reactor from the Timer's tickers
    # while DoTick() iterates over them, segfaulting ReactorTests.Retire on macOS;
    # upstream cyclus/cycamore@eedfc1d83f from https://github.com/cyclus/cycamore/pull/609
    - patches/schedule-decommission-in-reactor-tick.patch

build:
  number: 4
  skip: win
  # install.py does not use CMAKE_ARGS itself, but passes -D options to CMake, so
  # pass CMAKE_ARGS (each a -D option) to keep CMake from finding libraries and
  # frameworks on the runner (e.g. Homebrew), and pin Python3 to the host Python
  script: >-
    ${PYTHON} install.py
    --prefix="${PREFIX}"
    ${CMAKE_ARGS}
    -DPython3_EXECUTABLE="${PYTHON}"
    -j "${CPU_COUNT}"

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - cmake
    - make
    - pkgconf
  host:
    - python
    - cyclus
    # libcycamore links to libhdf5 and libglibmm-2.68 directly
    - hdf5
    - glibmm-2.68
  run:
    - python
    - cyclus ${{ version }}.*
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage("cycamore", upper_bound="x.x") }}

tests:
  - package_contents:
      lib:
        - cyclus/libcycamore
      bin:
        - cycamore_unit_tests

  - files:
      source:
        - input
        - tests
    requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - pytables
    script:
      - cyclus -l :cycamore

      - cycamore_unit_tests

      - cd tests
      - pytest -vv

about:
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.rst
  summary: The Cyclus additional modules repository.
  homepage: http://fuelcycle.org/
  repository: http://github.com/cyclus/cycamore
  documentation: https://fuelcycle.org/
